raw_findings.body: Because the pre-existing LRU cache key in `I18n.translate` (`"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`) does not include the resolved default/fallback locale, previously cached fallback translations keep returning text resolved against the old default locale until the process restarts or the cache entry is evicted.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Users may continue to see translations resolved against a stale default locale after a runtime configuration change, with no error or indication of the staleness.
raw_findings.impact: Because the pre-existing LRU cache key in `I18n.translate` (`"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`) does not include the resolved default/fallback locale, previously cached fallback translations keep returning text resolved against the old default locale until the process restarts or the cache entry is evicted.
raw_findings.root_cause: Fallback resolution was newly made dependent on the mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the existing translation LRU cache key was not updated to account for that dependency.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Include the current `SiteSetting.default_locale` (or a fallback-chain version token) in the translation cache key, or clear `@cache` when the `default_locale` site setting changes.
raw_findings.title: Fallback chain now depends on mutable SiteSetting.default_locale but translation cache key ignores it
raw_findings.trigger: An admin changes the `default_locale` site setting after users on a non-default locale have already triggered translation lookups that fell back (and were cached) to the previous default locale.

finding.verifier_reason: This is speculative. The cache key at line 72 uses config.locale which is the user's current locale. The fallback mechanism in I18n::Backend::Fallbacks handles resolution at translation time, not at cache lookup time. The claim that cached translations would be stale requires proving the cache stores fallback-resolved values keyed only by primary locale, but translate_no_cache delegates to the backend which handles fallbacks dynamically.
